column1: # The firmware's text, in every language it speaks.

# habit as the key table and the fonts. The identifiers come from these keys, so
# a key renamed or removed breaks the build instead of leaving an empty label on
# Columns are tab-separated: key, then one column per language. The heading row
# names them, and its names become LangEN, LangFR and so on.
# English first because the code is English and because a label written in the
# language the layout was tuned to is the one that never overflows. French is

column2: This volume was not unmounted properly. Okapia can repair it before starting, which takes a few seconds and does not touch your files.
column3: Ce volume n’a pas été démonté proprement. Okapia peut le réparer avant de démarrer, ce qui prend quelques secondes et ne touche pas à vos fichiers.

column2: The Macintosh has not started, so nothing is open and nothing can be lost. Okapia will stop, and the screen will go dark before you switch the power off.
column3: Le Macintosh n’a pas démarré : rien n’est ouvert, rien ne peut être perdu. Okapia va s’arrêter, et l’écran s’éteindra avant que vous coupiez l’alimentation.

column2: The parameter RAM holds what the Macintosh remembers about itself — its startup disk, its sound level, the depth of its screen. Forgetting it restores the factory values and touches none of your files.
column3: La PRAM contient ce que le Macintosh retient de lui-même : son disque de démarrage, son niveau sonore, la profondeur de son écran. L’oublier rétablit les valeurs d’usine et ne touche à aucun de vos fichiers.
